version.changelog:
- Initial release of the "课堂互动教练" skill.
- Supports teachers in upgrading from one-way lecturing to interactive, thinking-driven classrooms.
- Provides workflows for Socratic questioning, group work design, cold-room handling, and instant feedback based on teaching objectives and student profiles.
- Integrates with lesson planner and student analyzer for differentiated, targeted interaction strategies.
- Includes clear boundaries: does not automate observation, student calling, or recording—teacher remains in control.

llm.summary: This is a classroom interaction coaching skill with disclosed educational data-flow notes and no executable code, network access, credentials, or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe a teacher-facing classroom interaction coach for questioning, group work, cold-room handling, and feedback design.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Activation phrases are broad and could route ordinary teaching requests to this skill, but the resulting behavior is limited to lesson-planning guidance and disclosed classroom workflow coordination.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown instruction files and one markdown reference file; no scripts, package installs, binaries, or runtime hooks were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No API keys, environment variables, network calls, local credential reads, or system-command instructions were found; the stated dependencies are other teaching skills.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill discusses writing back classroom observation data to lesson-log/student-analyzer, but it explicitly limits writeback to aggregate signals and prohibits student names or individual error records.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install if you want classroom-interaction planning help. Review the broad triggers and the stigmatizing wording before use in a school setting, and keep any classroom notes aggregated rather than naming individual students.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad classroom trigger phrases are real, but they only activate a purpose-aligned classroom coaching workflow and do not create high-impact access or hidden execution.
[SQP-3] unexpected: The term “差生” in the trigger description is stigmatizing and should be replaced with neutral wording; the body otherwise uses more protective framing and includes anti-shaming rules.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry reported no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
[staticScan] expected: The static scan reported no findings, and local artifact inspection found no executable files or undisclosed privileged behavior.
